DIAGNOSIS READY: Legg-Calvé-Perthes Disease

The absence of fever, trauma, and inflammatory markers strongly supports an avascular necrosis of the femoral head rather than septic arthritis or acute osteomyelitis. I am confident this is Perthes disease given the age, insidious onset of limping, and knee pain (referred from the hip), so no further testing is needed at this time.
